items.headline: $RUNE: THORChain Refuses Bitget's Hacker-Address Block
items.summary: THORChain pushed back on Bitget's demand to block flagged hacker addresses, even as one completed an XRP-to-BTC swap. OKX's Star Xu challenged $RUNE's Bitcoin comparison.

items.headline: $DOGE ETFs Notch Record Week Despite Bitwise Exit
items.summary: Dogecoin ETFs posted record weekly inflows even as Bitwise signaled exit plans. Traders are watching whether $DOGE price finally reacts to the demand spike.

items.headline: $ETH to 2030: Buterin's 'Cryptographic World Computer'
items.summary: Vitalik Buterin said Ethereum is "really not just a blockchain anymore," mapping a post-Hegota path built on proof aggregation, censorship resistance and wallet flexibility for $ETH.

items.headline: $MORPHO Blames AI Tool for Deleted Curator Post
items.summary: Morpho says an AI marketing tool authored a deleted post that called its own curator business model broken, stirring fresh debate around $MORPHO's DeFi lending design.

items.headline: $AAVE V4 on Base Adds Coinbase Tokenized Stocks
items.summary: Coinbase tokenized stocks went live on Aave V4 via Base, expanding blue-chip DeFi collateral options and putting $AAVE at the center of the RWA lending push.
